title: OXR triple cube distribution
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and let $S$ be the set of signs. The OXR triple cube distribution on arrays of signs indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}(n)\times\mathrm{Fin}(3)$ is the independent product of $n$ copies of the coordinate OXR triple distribution with parameter $\delta$.
caveat: The coordinate OXR distribution and independent product construction are not defined in the supplied context.
